context.goal: Make NW.js release launcher non-blocking when run from terminal, while preserving default tailing behavior.

changes.summary: Added --detach/--bg/--background mode: starts CircuitSimulator, writes to debug.log, prints PID and exits without tail/wait.
Added passthrough --detach/--bg flag; after build, runs run_release_debug.sh in detached or interactive mode.
Documented detached mode usage for terminal workflows.
Added NW.js usage section and clarified troubleshooting for package.nw launcher behavior.

verification.manual_smoke: ./scripts/run_release_debug.sh --detach prints PID and exits; background process confirmed via ps; then killed.

notes: Default behavior of run_release_debug.sh remains: tail -f debug.log and wait for process.
Detached mode is intended for terminal use to avoid blocking.
